bgm.prompt: Calm instrumental underscore for a quiet night drive on an empty country road. Soft warm electric piano and gentle analog synth pads, a slow steady pulse like distant tyres on asphalt, subtle sub bass, sparse muted percussion. Patient, focused, reassuring and slightly mysterious, never tense or dramatic. Around 72 BPM, even dynamics from start to end, no sudden hits, no vocals, no lead melody that competes with a narrator.
